invariants: locale bundles belong to one definition
stable field/option/item IDs never change when text changes
switching locale changes no canonical value, applicability, routing, constraint or option
locale is not an expression context
a locale change clears pending acknowledgments and invalidates the review digest while leaving canonical answers and applicability unchanged
only complete approved locales may be advertised
no silent fallback to English for an advertised locale
Roman-script Hindi or English text labeled Hindi is not a substitute for a native-script pack
long labels, plural messages and RTL layout are covered
